title: HAXElementSchema
description: Schema for the lightweight HAX element representation used in demoSchema and runtime element conversion.

tag.description: Tag name for the element to create (for example: block-quote, simple-img, p).

properties.description: Properties and attributes to assign to the target element.

content.description: Light DOM string content used as inner HTML.

eventName.description: Optional event metadata attached by insertion or conversion workflows.
